findings.title: Gate @security-tag check was vacuous (the heading itself contains the token)
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: a future per-sheet author ships a scenario with no @security tag and the gate passes, so the scenario is not selectable or runnable as a security autotest in the shared index
findings.evidence: reviewer copied the gate into a fixture with a valid-but-untagged scenario -> PASS, exit 0; the token @security appeared only on the heading line that the check scanned
findings.resolution: gate now scans the section BODY below the heading (secBlock.slice(indexOf('\n')+1)); added a discriminating test (Gherkin keywords present but no @security tag -> exit 1). Re-verified: catalog test 13/13, real gate PASS 3/137

findings.title: Manifest-to-SKILL.md index consistency was only half-enforced
findings.question: ownership
findings.whatBreaks: the hand-maintained 137-row routing table is a second copy of the manifest; the gate only checked done sheets + orphans, so a missing/renamed/extra pending row could drift silently until that sheet became done
findings.evidence: reviewer: the pending-skip at :79 precedes the index assertion; no code compared the table to the manifest for pending sheets or counts
findings.resolution: gate now asserts every manifest slug is indexed in SKILL.md and every indexed slug has a manifest entry; added a discriminating test (drop a slug from the index -> exit 1). Re-verified green
